title: Training for Educators and School Counsellors on Mental Health Assessment of Students
what_it_is: Training for Educators and School Counsellors on Mental Health Assessment of Students

sections.label: Teachers and school counsellors support
sections.summary: Teachers are equipped to build mutual care, spot distress and support students, referring complex cases to qualified school counsellors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: If I may continue, yes, our teachers and school counsellors are equipped to help students in the psychological and mental health-related domains.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: Teachers are the first line of contact for all students.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: We have, therefore, equipped them with the competencies to carry out three specific roles.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: First, teachers establish amongst classmates a culture of mutual care and support and teach students life skills to improve their emotional resilience.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: Second, teachers recognise common distress signals and identify students who need help.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: Third, teachers engage with such students to understand their issues and provide care and support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: For complex cases requiring more extensive support, teachers will refer students to school counsellors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: All school counsellors have professional qualifications in counselling.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: They provide interventions for psychological and mental health-related issues, such as anxiety, depression, relationship problems and suicidal behaviours.
